Exact seed-level sign-flip randomization (2^30 by DP, perm.py): nemo3_4b 1.74e-11->1.79e-07; nemo3_30b 9.63e-11->8.34e-07; nemo3_120b 5.12e-12->2.38e-07; gemma4_e2b 1.29e-67->1.86e-09; exaone_236b 6.58e-23->3.73e-09; glm_47 2.44e-03->5.19e-02. glm_47's seed design effect 2.722 is 2nd largest in the family (repo max 2.969). 13 of its 30 seeds tie; +27 comes from 6 seeds.

What fails is the magnitude and the sensitivity claim: at 5.19e-02, Holm(21) rank-12 threshold 5.0e-03 would NOT admit it. Caveat: the seed test discards within-seed pairing, so a pairing-preserving cluster test sits between 2.44e-03 and 5.19e-02.

reports.summary: Two headline claims do not survive. (1) "Length is not the explanation … 5 noise-higher, 0 extens-higher" is near-tautological: all 6 quarantined lanes are extens-higher, the only non-quarantined extens-higher lane is the disclosed glm_47, and the quarantine criterion (noise-arm collapse) mechanically forces that direction; the noise arm is also not a validated length control (padding alone is Holm-significant vs intens in 7/21 lanes, −0.996 to +0.085). (2) "3 of 7 families scale cleanly" fails the study's own caveat 11: propagating the measured ±1.2 pt process SD drops deduction Holm 17/21 → 13/21 and kills both interior qwen3.5 rungs, so it becomes 2 of 7; caveat 6's licensing sentence is a non sequitur. The deduction info-vs-length null is a far weaker manipulation than advertised (hint:3 vs noise:3 differ ONLY in a 1-hop transitive block; both carry full direct premises), and that whole family is missing from the "both legs" doc it cites. Quarantine is also asymmetric: min3_14b extens (46.3% empty + 34.1% degenerate) is only flagged; a symmetric rule cuts findings 48→36.

findings.claim: "Direction among clean significant results: 5 noise-higher, 0 extens-higher" / "Length is not the explanation … the extensional arm's difficulty is label density, not prompt length."
findings.evidence: Recomputed all 21 extens-vs-noise contrasts from raw marks (scratchpad/headline-scrutiny/dir.py): 14 noise-higher, 7 extens-higher. ALL SIX quarantined lanes are extens-higher (glm_flash .393>.122, glm_air .741>.607, min3_8b .222>.215, min3_14b .081>.026, exaone_32b .141>.000, exaone_33b .741>.000); the only non-quarantined extens-higher lane is glm_47. The quarantine criterion IS noise-arm collapse (significance_report.py:63-70) — noise accuracy driven to 0 mechanically forces extens>noise. So the exclusion rule is 6/6 aligned with the direction it removes. FAMILY_LADDER:186 bolds the unanimity; :188-203 discloses only glm_47, never the 6/6 alignment.
findings.correction: Disclose the direction of the exclusions: 3 of the 5 excluded significant lanes are extens-higher, and 6 of 7 extens-higher lanes overall are removed by a criterion definitionally satisfied when the noise arm scores near 0. Narrow the claim to: among lanes where whitespace padding is demonstrably inert, an enumerated listing is harder than the equivalent rule at matched token length.

findings.claim: The noise_intens arm is a valid length control: "this contrast holds prompt length fixed and varies only whether the tokens carry information."
findings.evidence: The intens-vs-noise contrast measures the pad's own effect and it is Holm-significant (m=210) in 7 of 21 lanes: glm_flash −0.167, glm_47 −0.170 (p=3.16e-10, a CLEAN lane), glm_air −0.363, min3_8b −0.574, min3_14b −0.444, exaone_32b −0.889, exaone_33b −0.996 (scratchpad/headline-scrutiny/pad.py). In nemo3_4b the pad IMPROVES accuracy +0.085. The doc never tests pad-inertness; it substitutes the curated quarantine list. Also both arms are fully informative — noise_intens contains the complete rule plus tabs (results/glm_air_noise_intens/rep_0.yaml) — so "varies only whether the tokens carry information" is false; extens_vs_noise.py:1-9 states it correctly.
findings.correction: Reframe as "extensional vs intensional encoding at matched token length", and add the pad-inertness check the argument needs: in the 5 headline lanes the intens-vs-noise delta is non-significant (+0.085, −0.019, −0.004, +0.033, −0.022), which is the actual and unstated reason those 5 support the inference.

findings.claim: "Scaling holds cleanly in 3 of 7 families — qwen3.5, gemma-4 and GLM, where every rung-pair is positive and Holm-significant" / "17 of 21 ladder contrasts separate".
findings.evidence: I reproduced 17/21 exactly by exact-McNemar Holm on the report's own b/c counts (proc2.py vs ERROR_BARS_REPORT.txt:43-63). The BCa bootstrap resamples THEOREMS only — no generation-variance component. Caveat 11 (FAMILY_LADDER:534-549) measures that component: 9.5% flip ⇒ ±1.2 pt SD (I verified sqrt(.095)/sqrt(712)=0.0115). Adding 0.012 in quadrature drops Holm to 13/21, losing qwen3.5-27b vs 122b (p .0026→.0147), 122b vs 397b (.0063→.0273), ministral 3b vs 14b (.0054→.039), deepseek flash vs pro (.0014→.0079). Both INTERIOR qwen3.5 rungs die, so clean-scaling becomes 2 of 7.
findings.correction: Either propagate the measured process term (17→13; "3 of 7"→2 of 7), or state in §2.4 that the CIs exclude a measured ±1.2 pt per-lane variance component and that four rejections — including two of qwen3.5's three — sit inside it. The +0.050 27b-vs-122b contrast §2.4:321-326 uses to refute the active-parameter hypothesis is one of the four.

findings.claim: Caveat 6: "Because every lane runs on its own hardware by design, this does not correlate with the model axis: it is noise, not bias, and re-runs cannot remove it. Do not chase it."
findings.evidence: The inference is inverted. If every lane runs on its own hardware, process identity is perfectly ALIASED with model identity, so for a between-model contrast — which every §2.4/§2.5 contrast is — the process term enters the difference directly rather than averaging out. Caveat 11 quantifies it at ±1.2 pt/lane and the doc never propagates it (see the 17→13 finding); "Do not chase it" is the sentence licensing that omission. Caveat 6 itself concedes it cannot state a rate: "8/8 in one of six archived pairings, 0/8 in four … do not treat 0/8 as 'the' cross-process rate" (:478-481).
findings.correction: Replace with: process identity is uncorrelated with model SIZE but aliased with model IDENTITY, so it contributes an unmodelled ~±1.2 pt variance term to every between-model contrast, and the reported intervals do not include it.

findings.claim: Quarantine ("output-contract collapse") is applied consistently; extens arms with the same collapse are merely flagged [!].
findings.evidence: No threshold, two metrics, one hand-coded noise-only set (significance_report.py:65-70). Caveat 9 justifies glm_flash/glm_air by EMPTY rate (verified 132/270=48.9%, 48/270=17.8%) and min3 by NON-COMPLIANCE (100%). Like-for-like, min3_14b's EXTENS arm is 125/270=46.3% empty plus 92/270=34.1% degenerate-repetition — worse than quarantined glm_air — yet only flagged, and it carries the entire "min3 inverts" story. Within noise arms too: min3_3b/noise 44.8% non-compliant is NOT quarantined (noise-higher, supports headline) while glm_air/noise 30.7% IS (extens-higher).
findings.correction: State one criterion and threshold for all four arms, or say the set is curated by inspection. Report the counterfactual (sym3.py): applying the quarantined set's own minimum (30.7%) symmetrically quarantines 15 cells not 6 and moves 48 findings/20 quarantined/57 controls → 36/39/50, erasing all five min3 ladder findings and 2 of 3 exaone extens ladder findings. The clean-5 headline survives it.
